- `path.setFirstVertex` (writes): Makes one vertex (the single selected vertex, or `layer`, `mask` uid and `index`) the first vertex of its mask path; this changes how mask interpolation and stroke start points line up.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `layer` integer
  - `mask` integer, uid
- `path.freeTransform` (writes): Free Transform Points: scale / rotate / move the selected vertices (or whole masks) about an anchor (default: the centre of their bounding box), at the current time.
  - `anchor` number[]
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layer` integer
  - `layers` array, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `mask` integer
  - `offset` number[], [dx, dy]
  - `path` string, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `rotation` number, degrees
  - `scale` number, % | [x%, y%]

### Effect

- `effect.applyLast` (writes): Applies the most recently applied effect again, to `layers` or the selection, with the same parameters as effect.apply. Fails when no effect has been applied in this session.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `effect` string, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layer` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layers` integer[]
- `effect.removeAll` (writes): Deletes every effect from `layers` (default selected) in one undo step. To remove one effect use effect.remove; to turn effects off without deleting, toggle the layer's effects switch.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layer` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layers` integer[]
- `effect.manage` (writes): Editor window only: opens the Manage Effects dialog. Headless sessions accept it and change nothing; effect.plugins.list reports plug-ins. No parameters.

### Layer > Switches

- `layer.hideOtherVideo` (writes): Turns off the video switch of every audio/visual layer in the comp except `layers` (default selected), to see those alone. Undoable; turn layers back on with their video switch.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layer` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layers` integer[]
- `layer.showAllVideo` (writes): Turns the video switch on for every layer in `comp` except track mattes, undoing layer.hideOtherVideo.
  - `comp` integer or string
- `layer.unlockAll` (writes): Unlocks every layer in `comp`.
  - `comp` integer or string

### Layer > Reveal

- `layer.revealSource` (writes): Selects `layer`'s source item in the project panel and shows the panel. Returns {item}.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `layer` integer
- `comp.revealInProject` (reads): Selects `comp` in the project panel and shows the panel. Returns {item}; changes no content.
  - `comp` integer or string
- `layer.revealExpressionErrors` (reads): Finds the properties whose expressions fail in `comp` at the current time, reveals them in the timeline and returns them with their errors.
  - `comp` integer or string

### View > Switch View Layout

- `view.shareViewOptions` (reads): Sets (`value`) or toggles whether all viewers share the same view options. Viewer state only. Returns the new value.
  - `value` boolean

### File > Dependencies

- `file.collectFiles` (writes): Copies the project and every footage file it uses into `folder` (footage goes into `(Footage)`), renaming clashes, and points the copy at the collected files. Returns copied count and errors. The open project is unchanged.
  - `folder` file
- `file.consolidateFootage` (writes): Merges footage items that use the same file with the same interpretation into one item and points every layer at it; returns how many duplicates were removed. No parameters.
- `file.removeUnusedFootage` (writes): Deletes footage and solid items that no layer in any composition uses. Returns {removed}; compositions and folders stay. No parameters.
- `file.reduceProject` (writes): Deletes every project item the selected compositions don't use (directly or through nested comps and footage). Select the comps to keep in the project first; returns {removed}. No parameters.
- `file.relinkFootage` (writes): Run the recorded jobs in a worker session (sharing `footage`).
  - `dryRun` boolean, report only
  - `folder` file, recursive desktop search, no symlinks; max 100000 entries
  - `wait` boolean, return results inline; otherwise jobs.list/jobs.wait

### File > Scripts

- `file.runScript` (writes): File ▸ Scripts ▸ Run Script File…: `.jsx` / `.js` files run as JavaScript against the After Effects-style object model ([`Session::script`]); anything else is a command script: a JSON array or JSON lines of `{"command": id, "params": {…}}` (also accepts the control channel's `{"method": "engine.execute", "params": {"id", "params"}}`).
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `name` string, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `path` file, (.jsx/.js JavaScript, or a .jsonl/.json command script) | name (an installed or sample script, see file.scripts.list) | steps: [{command, params}]
  - `steps` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
- `file.installScript` (writes): Copies the script at `path` (.jsx or .js) into the Scripts folder so it appears in File › Scripts; it does not run it. Run scripts with file.runScript.
  - `path` file, .jsx / .js
- `file.installScriptPanel` (writes): Copies the script panel script at `path` (.jsx or .js) into the Script Panels folder so it appears in the Window menu; it does not run it.
  - `path` file, .jsx / .js

### File > Interpret Footage

- `file.interpretFootage` (writes): Sets how footage `items` (default selected) is read: `frameRate`, `alpha` (straight, premultiplied, ignore, guess), `invertAlpha`, `loop`, `pixelAspect`, `fields`, `colorProfile`, `linearLight`, start timecode. Layers using it change accordingly.
  - `alpha` string, one of `straight` | `premultiplied` | `ignore` | `guess`
  - `colorProfile` string, one of `srgb` | `rec709` | `rec2020` | `p3` | `auto`
  - `fields` string, one of `off` | `upper` | `lower`
  - `frameRate` json, fps|"file"
  - `guessAlpha` boolean
  - `invertAlpha` boolean
  - `item` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `items` integer[]
  - `linearLight` boolean
  - `loop` json
  - `matteColor` json
  - `overrideStart` boolean, false: Use Source File Timecode
  - `pixelAspect` number
  - `preserveRgb` boolean, the file's values unconverted
  - `startTimecode` string, timecode|frame (Override Start); Override Start
- `file.rememberInterpretation` (writes): Remembers the interpretation (alpha, frame rate, fields, colour) of footage `item` (default the selected one) so file.applyInterpretation can copy it to other footage. Changes nothing itself.
  - `item` integer
  - `items` array, read by the command beside its listed parameters
- `file.applyInterpretation` (writes): Applies the remembered footage interpretation (alpha, frame rate, fields, colour; remembered with Remember Interpretation) to `items` (default the selected footage). Fails if none is remembered.
  - `item` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `items` integer[]
- `file.interpretProxy` (writes): File ▸ Interpret Footage ▸ Proxy: Interpret Footage settings for the proxy file.
  - `alpha` string
  - `colorProfile` string
  - `fields` string
  - `frameRate` json
  - `guessAlpha` boolean, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `invertAlpha` boolean
  - `item` integer, one of several alternative parameters
  - `items` integer[], one of several alternative parameters
  - `linearLight` boolean
  - `loop` json
  - `matteColor` json
  - `pixelAspect` number

### File > Replace Footage

- `file.replaceFootage` (writes): Points footage `item` (default selected) at the file at `path`, keeping every layer that uses it; a numbered still brings its image sequence unless `sequence: false`. Use for swapping media without rebuilding layers.
  - `alphabetical` boolean
  - `item` integer
  - `path` file
  - `sequence` boolean, default true: a numbered still brings its image sequence
- `file.replaceWithPlaceholder` (writes): Turns footage `item` into a placeholder with its size, frame rate and duration (override with `width`, `height`, `frameRate`, `duration`), keeping the layers that use it.
  - `duration` number
  - `frameRate` number
  - `height` number
  - `item` integer
  - `items` array, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `width` number
- `file.replaceWithSolid` (writes): Turns footage `item` into a solid of `color` (size defaults to the footage's), keeping every layer that uses it.
  - `color` string
  - `height` number
  - `item` integer
  - `items` array, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `width` number
- `file.replaceWithLayeredComp` (writes): File ▸ Replace Footage ▸ With Layered Comp: a layered (Photoshop) footage item becomes a composition of its layers; every layer using the footage now uses the comp, and the footage item goes. One undo step.
  - `item` integer

### File > Export

- `file.exportLottie` (reads): Writes `comp` as Lottie to `path` (.json, or .lottie for dotLottie); `includeExpressions` keeps expressions, `textAsShapes` converts text to shapes. Returns path, bytes and warnings for features Lottie can't hold.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `includeExpressions` boolean
  - `path` file, .json or .lottie
  - `textAsShapes` boolean
- `file.exportTimeline` (reads): Exports `comp` as an editing timeline to `path`: Final Cut Pro XML for Premiere Pro (default), .fcpxml, .otio, .edl, .aaf or .omf (`format`). `prerender` renders layers the format can't express; `precomps` nest or prerender.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `format` string, one of `xml` | `fcpxml` | `otio` | `edl` | `aaf` | `omf`
  - `path` file, Final Cut Pro XML .xml for Premiere Pro or .fcpxml .otio .edl .aaf .omf
  - `precomps` string, one of `nest` | `prerender`
  - `prerender` string, one of `none` | `unsupported` | `all`
- `templateProps.exportTemplate` (writes): Writes `comp` and everything it uses, with its Graphics Templates controls, as a template file at `path` (.ectemplate); footage is packed beside it. Fails if the comp has no Graphics Templates controls.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `name` string
  - `path` file, .ectemplate
- `file.exportMovie` (reads): Renders the active composition to H.264 MP4 through a scratch Render Queue item and returns it (base64 `data`, `mime`, `bytes`); only `format: mp4`. Writes no file and leaves the project's queue as it is: use <prefix>_export to save.
  - `format` json, mp4

### Composition > Save Frame As

- `comp.saveFrameAs` (writes): Writes the frame at `time` (default now) as a PNG to `path`, at `scale`; `queue: true` adds a Render Queue item instead. Use comp.saveFrameAsPsd or comp.saveFrameAsExr for layered stills, file.exportMovie for video.
  - `comp` integer, read by the command beside its listed parameters
  - `path` file, .png; with queue: an output path or template
  - `queue` boolean, add a Render Queue item from the Frame Default templates instead of writing now
  - `scale` number
  - `time` number
- `comp.saveFrameAsPsd` (writes): Writes the frame at `time` as a layered Photoshop file to `path` (.psd): one layer per visible comp layer with its blend mode and opacity, plus the merged frame. Returns path, layer count and size.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `path` file, .psd
  - `scale` number
  - `time` number
- `comp.saveFrameAsExr` (writes): Writes the frame at `time` as a multi-layer OpenEXR to `path` (.exr): the composite plus R,G,B,A per visible layer, linear and premultiplied. Returns path, channels, width, height and time.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `path` file, .exr
  - `scale` number
  - `time` number

### Composition > Preview

- `playback.toggle` (reads): Editor window only: starts or stops the preview of the active comp. Headless sessions accept it and change nothing; render a still or movie to see results.
  - `shortcut` string, one of `spacebar` | `shiftSpacebar` | `numpad0` | `shiftNumpad0` | `altNumpad0`, whose Preview panel options to use; default spacebar
- `playback.cacheWhenIdle` (reads): Editor window only: turns caching frames while idle on or off. Headless sessions accept it and change nothing.
  - `value` string
- `playback.audio` (reads): Editor window only: turns preview audio on or off. Headless sessions accept it and change nothing.
  - `value` string, include audio in previews

### View > Resolution

- `view.res.full` (reads): Frontend-only: previews the viewer at full resolution. Render resolution is set on the render queue item, not here. No parameters.
- `view.res.half` (reads): Frontend-only: previews the viewer at half resolution. Render resolution is set on the render queue item, not here. No parameters.
- `view.res.third` (reads): Frontend-only: previews the viewer at third resolution. Render resolution is set on the render queue item, not here. No parameters.
- `view.res.quarter` (reads): Frontend-only: previews the viewer at quarter resolution. Render resolution is set on the render queue item, not here. No parameters.
- `view.res.custom` (reads): Frontend-only: opens the custom viewer-resolution dialog. Render resolution is set on the render queue item, not here.
  - `factor` integer, 1 to 40; render every n-th pixel

### Window > Workspace

- `window.saveWorkspace` (reads): Frontend-only: saves the current panel layout into the current workspace. Headless sessions accept it and do nothing. No parameters.
- `window.saveWorkspaceAs` (reads): Frontend-only: saves the current panel layout as a new workspace. Headless sessions accept it and do nothing.
  - `name` string
- `window.editWorkspaces` (reads): Frontend-only: opens the workspace editor. Headless sessions accept it and do nothing.
  - `delete` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `rename` json, new name
- `window.resetWorkspace` (reads): Frontend-only: restores the current workspace's saved panel layout. Headless sessions accept it and do nothing. No parameters.

### File > Open Recent

- `file.clearRecent` (writes): Empties the Open Recent projects list in the preferences. Changes no project. No parameters.

### File > Import Recent Footage

- `file.clearRecentFootage` (writes): Empties the Import Recent Footage list in the preferences. Changes no project. No parameters.

### Animation > Recent Animation Presets

- `anim.clearRecentPresets` (writes): Empties the Recent Animation Presets list in the preferences. Changes no composition. No parameters.

### Composition > VR

- `comp.vr.createEnvironment` (writes): Composition ▸ VR ▸ Create VR Environment: renders the active comp's 3D scene in every direction.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `position` array, [x,y,z]
  - `size` integer, face pixels (1024); 1024
- `comp.vr.extractCubemap` (writes): Composition ▸ VR ▸ Extract Cubemap: a 3:2 cube-map comp of an equirectangular comp (VR Converter, equirectangular → cube map), for editing the faces. One undo step.
  - `comp` integer or string
  - `faceSize` integer

### File > Set Proxy

- `file.setProxy` (writes): Sets the file at `path` as the proxy for footage or compositions `items` (default selected); with proxies on, layers render the proxy instead. Returns the items and the proxy's size.
  - `item` integer, one of several alternative parameters
  - `items` integer[], one of several alternative parameters
  - `path` file
- `file.setProxyNone` (writes): Removes the proxy from `items` (default selected), so layers render the original again. Returns the items.
  - `item` integer, one of several alternative parameters
  - `items` integer[], one of several alternative parameters

## Examples

From [`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md).

### Example 1: a designed title, exported as MP4

A new project is 1920 × 1080 at 30 fps. Make the background, the title and the subtitle:

```json
motion_run {"path": "Title.kmotion", "steps": [
  {"command": "comp.settings", "params": {"duration": 4}},
  {"command": "layer.newSolid", "params": {"name": "Background", "color": "#141b2d"}},
  {"command": "layer.newText", "params": {"text": "Kition", "position": [960, 500], "size": 150, "style": "Bold", "fill": "#ffffff"}},
  {"command": "layer.newText", "params": {"text": "Documents your agent can edit", "position": [960, 640], "size": 52, "style": "Medium", "fill": "#c7d2fe"}}
]}
```

Answer: `completed: [{command: "comp.settings", result: {duration: 4, frameRate: 30, width: 1920,
height: 1080}}, {command: "layer.newSolid", result: {layer: 4}}, {command: "layer.newText",
result: {layer: 27}}, {command: "layer.newText", result: {layer: 66}}]`. Then give the frame depth
and motion, by the new layers' ids:

```json
motion_run {"path": "Title.kmotion", "steps": [
  {"command": "effect.apply", "params": {"effect": "Gradient Ramp", "layers": [4],
    "params": {"shape": 1, "start": [960, 430], "startColor": "#3a4566", "end": [2208, 430], "endColor": "#090c14"}}},
  {"command": "layer.style.add", "params": {"style": "outerGlow", "layers": [27], "params": {"size": 38, "opacity": 60, "color": "#a5b4fc"}}},
  {"command": "layer.style.add", "params": {"style": "dropShadow", "layers": [66], "params": {"distance": 8, "size": 24, "opacity": 50}}},
  {"command": "layer.applyTextPreset", "params": {"layer": 27, "preset": "blurSlide", "start": 0.2}},
  {"command": "layer.applyTextPreset", "params": {"layer": 66, "preset": "blurSlide", "variant": "subtitle", "start": 0.8}}
]}
motion_check {"path": "Title.kmotion"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
motion_export {"path": "Title.kmotion", "format": "mp4", "to": "Title.mp4"}
→ {"format": "mp4", "files": [{"path": "Title.mp4", "created": true}]}
```

### Example 2: fixing what the check finds

```json
motion_check {"path": "Intro.kmotion"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "motion.missing-parent", "severity": "error", "target": {"path": "comp:1/layer:4"},
    "message": "Layer \"Background\" in \"Comp 1\" is parented to a layer that no longer exists.",
    "fix": {"command": "layer.setParent", "params": {"comp": 1, "layers": [4], "parent": null, "compensate": false}}}]}
motion_run {"path": "Intro.kmotion", "steps": [
  {"command": "layer.setParent", "params": {"comp": 1, "layers": [4], "parent": null, "compensate": false}}
]}
motion_check {"path": "Intro.kmotion"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```

A layer that never shows:

```json
motion_check {"path": "Outro.kmotion"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "motion.zero-duration", "severity": "warning", "target": {"path": "comp:1/layer:4"},
    "fix": {"command": "edit.clear", "params": {"comp": 1, "layers": [4]}}}]}
motion_run {"path": "Outro.kmotion", "steps": [{"command": "edit.clear", "params": {"comp": 1, "layers": [4]}}]}
motion_check {"path": "Outro.kmotion"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```
